Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Alfonzina usually hope their child will grow to embody noble, one who is not afraid and live with faith, good character and purpose.

However, her marriage was never consummated due to the intervention of King Charles VIII of France, who sought to marry Alfonzina himself. The matter was eventually resolved through diplomacy, and Alfonzina was sent to live in Naples where she bore her husband two children before his death in 1494.
